ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels to 20% low-intensity black pixels, concentrated in a central vertical column and along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black blob bifurcating from the median notch downwards; continuous thin black banding along the entire trailing edge and lobe tips; multiple discrete linear black strokes distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; the right lobe trailing edge contains deeper pixel-amplitude valleys (scalloping) compared to the left lobe; peaks are sharpened at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into a slight upward concavity at the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of small, circular white high-contrast nodules visible in the lower-central region of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear rake marks; includes a prominent vertical stroke on the right lobe intersected by a perpendicular mark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent cross-shaped or 'T' pigment mark on the upper-inner quadrant of the right lobe; significant parallel linear rake marks across both lobes indicating historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct small, dark circular focal spot located near the distal trailing edge of the right lobe tip.
